name: deskcompat-workspace
description: Safe, modular macOS muscle-memory compatibility for Ubuntu GNOME

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && bun build apps/cli/src/main.ts --compile --outfile dist/deskcompat
scripts.ci: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run schema:check && bun run docs:check && bun test && bun run build && bun run test:binary
